heroTitle: Empowering Creators with Fast, Free Web Tools
heroDesc: Our vision is to simplify daily developer and user workflows by building privacy-focused, browser-based utilities that require no installation or registration.
feature1Desc: All operations run locally in your browser for maximum processing speed.
feature2Desc: Your files and text are processed client-side and never uploaded to external servers.
feature3Desc: No paywalls, hidden limits, or forced sign-ups—just direct access to essential utilities.
toolFormatterDesc: Convert images to PNG, JPEG, or WEBP instantly.
toolCompressorDesc: Reduce image file size with adjustable quality controls.
toolPdfWriterDesc: Write paragraphs and export clean PDF documents easily.
toolPaletteDesc: Explore developer palettes and copy hex codes with one click.
toolEntitiesDesc: Find and copy named or numerical HTML symbols.
toolResumeDesc: Generate and print a professional resume instantly.
toolWeightDesc: Calculate BMI and find ideal body weight range.
toolHumanizerDesc: Convert AI text into realistic human writing style.
toolAiDetectorDesc: Check text for AI patterns and probability scores.
toolCompassDesc: Check directional heading using orientation sensors.
toolAudioTextDesc: Convert live microphone dictation into written text.
toolVideoAudioDesc: Extract clean MP3 audio directly from video files.
toolDeviceHealthDesc: Scan device RAM, CPU cores, battery, and speed.
toolWaterRemoverDesc: Play 165Hz sound waves to clean trapped water.
